acip: GNYIS PA LA GNYIS, DE KHO NA NYID RTOGS PA MI 'THAD PA'I RTZOD PA SPANG BA, MKHYEN PA PO MI 'THAD PA'I RTZOD PA SPANG BA'O, ,DANG PO NI,
wylie: gnyis pa la gnyis, de kho na nyid rtogs pa mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa spang ba, mkhyen pa po mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa spang ba'o, ,dang po ni
english: Which brings us to our second point from above: our actual refutation of argument on the way in which we first reach our enlightenment. Here we proceed in two steps: refuting argument which says that the idea of realizing suchness is mistaken; and then refuting argument which says that our idea about the one who gains the knowledge in this case is mistaken as well.
